allocation_assumption: First cluster comes from the deleted record; later clusters assume contiguous allocation. Original fragmentation is unknown.
note: Unverified deleted-file candidate in /. Assumes 2 contiguous free clusters. Original fragmentation and overwritten contents cannot be determined. A leading underscore replaces a lost short-name character. Long-name associations, when present, are tentative.

grade_definitions.good: Would require independent original-content evidence; this FAT-only recovery cannot assign it.
grade_definitions.possibly_good: Readable, stable bytes in the first recorded cluster; original contents are not verified.
grade_definitions.possibly_bad: Later bytes assume contiguous allocation, or original bytes may have been replaced by a current allocation. See disposition and reason.
grade_definitions.overwritten: Would require independent evidence of original-byte replacement. Allocation alone does not prove overwrite; this recovery does not assign it.
grade_definitions.unavailable: Unreadable or outside the validated volume; original contents unknown.

file_type_hint.interpretation: Shared magic/type detection is a header heuristic, not a content check. A match cannot verify the payload; no confidence grade is upgraded.

ranges.reason: allocated_or_reused_cluster; original contents are not recoverable from this allocation evidence
